findings.summary: Authenticated learners could create and read teacher classroom resources because no teacher role was enforced.
findings.reproduction: Call POST /api/v1/teacher/classrooms with a learner identity on the baseline revision.
findings.fix: Require trusted app_metadata.borza_role teacher/admin claims and enforce teacher ownership on every teacher route.
findings.remaining_risk: Role assignment remains an administrator operation that must be audited in Supabase.

findings.summary: Practical-finance tables did not explicitly enable RLS and revoke anon/authenticated access.
findings.reproduction: Inspect 0014 table grants and relrowsecurity state in PostgreSQL.
findings.fix: Migration 0015 enables RLS, revokes Data API roles, and adds server-only policies on seven tables.
findings.remaining_risk: Production must apply 0015 before serving this code.

findings.summary: The frontend image could not build root curriculum imports and then could not find the traced standalone server at runtime.
findings.reproduction: Build the baseline frontend Dockerfile from its frontend-only context and start the image.
findings.fix: Use repository-root context, copy curriculum content, preserve tracing-root layout, and run from /app/frontend.
findings.regression_test: CI production frontend container build and isolated runtime health check
findings.remaining_risk: Registry publication and hosted deployment were not performed in this assessment.

findings.summary: Public practical content exposed scoring, feedback, and solution fields.
findings.reproduction: GET /api/v1/practical-content and search recursively for answer/scoring keys.
findings.fix: Recursively filter solution and scoring keys and remove chart/calculator solutions from response schemas.
findings.remaining_risk: The labelled browser-local demo still bundles authored scoring metadata; see BORZA-QA-014.

findings.summary: Unexpected request fields were silently ignored, weakening mass-assignment defenses.
findings.reproduction: PUT /api/v1/profile with an extra role=admin field on the baseline.
findings.fix: All request models inherit extra=forbid and classroom settings are typed.
findings.remaining_risk: None confirmed.

findings.summary: Client buckets were unbounded and forwarded-IP spoofing could evade local limits.
findings.reproduction: Submit sensitive requests while rotating X-Forwarded-For and generate many synthetic client keys.
findings.fix: Use request.client, bounded LRU-style client storage, global and sensitive buckets, and Retry-After.
findings.remaining_risk: Per-process enforcement remains; see BORZA-QA-015.

findings.summary: Request bodies had no application-level size ceiling.
findings.reproduction: Send a 270 KB profile body on the baseline.
findings.fix: Reject declared or streamed bodies above 256 KiB with HTTP 413.
findings.remaining_risk: The edge proxy should enforce a compatible limit before application workers.

findings.summary: Expected-round validation did not lock the session row, allowing concurrent stale updates.
findings.reproduction: Issue simultaneous updates with the same expected_round against PostgreSQL.
findings.fix: Lock the session row with SELECT FOR UPDATE before validating and applying the transition.
findings.remaining_risk: High-volume distributed contention was not benchmarked.

findings.summary: Retries could create duplicate contact records.
findings.reproduction: Replay the same partnership request after a client timeout.
findings.fix: Hash optional Idempotency-Key values, fingerprint payloads, replay identical results, and reject conflicting reuse.
findings.remaining_risk: Clients that omit the optional key can still submit intentional duplicates.

findings.summary: Expiry blocked access but no operational deletion mechanism existed for expired records.
findings.reproduction: Advance records beyond expiry/retention and inspect persisted rows.
findings.fix: Add a dry-run-first retention CLI with explicit --confirm and cascading classroom deletion.
findings.remaining_risk: A production operator must schedule, monitor, and evidence the command.

findings.summary: Targets on the wrong side of an entry and nonpositive equity curves were accepted.
findings.reproduction: Submit entry=100, stop=95, target=90 or an equity curve containing zero.
findings.fix: Validate trade geometry and require strictly positive equity values.
findings.remaining_risk: Calculators remain educational and are not individualized advice.

findings.summary: The shared 30/minute sensitive bucket blocked legitimate 100-student classroom entry.
findings.reproduction: Attempt more than 30 classroom joins inside one minute from the class network.
findings.fix: Use a separate bounded 120/minute classroom-join bucket while retaining 30/minute sensitive limits.
findings.remaining_risk: Large institutions behind one NAT may need a reviewed platform policy.

findings.summary: Color-contrast auditing was disabled; shared anchor cascade caused serious CTA failures, and a loading main used an invalid status role.
findings.reproduction: Run axe with color-contrast enabled across desktop/mobile routes.
findings.fix: Move anchor defaults into the base CSS layer, enable contrast scans, and use aria-busy plus an h1 for loading.
findings.remaining_risk: Automated scans do not replace assistive-technology user testing.

findings.summary: Canonical practical scoring fields remain discoverable in client JavaScript for the labelled offline demo.
findings.reproduction: Search production static chunks for authored option IDs and quality/effect metadata.
findings.fix: Not changed because the complete offline demo intentionally uses the deterministic authored engine.
findings.regression_test: Authenticated evidence is covered by server-side scoring tests.
findings.remaining_risk: Demo results are not tamper-resistant; only authenticated server-scored evidence may be treated as authoritative.

findings.summary: Application rate limits are process-local and do not aggregate across replicas.
findings.reproduction: Distribute requests across two API workers and observe independent counters.
findings.fix: Documented platform/distributed enforcement requirement.
findings.remaining_risk: Configure Render/edge rate limiting before broad public exposure.

findings.summary: The deployed CSP permits unsafe-inline scripts and styles for Next.js hydration and preference bootstrap.
findings.reproduction: Inspect the Content-Security-Policy header on the production-shaped frontend.
findings.fix: HSTS and restrictive object/base/form/frame directives were retained; nonce/hash migration is documented.
findings.remaining_risk: An injection flaw would have weaker script-execution containment until nonces/hashes replace unsafe-inline.

findings.summary: Catalogue CLS measured 0.108 because content-visibility reserved inaccurate card heights.
findings.reproduction: Run npm run test:performance against the production image.
findings.fix: Remove content-visibility from the small fixed catalogue grid and add performance budgets.
findings.remaining_risk: Final local CLS is 0.085; hosted field data is still required.

findings.summary: Internal catalogue exceptions and exception text could reach clients or structured logs.
findings.reproduction: Force registry initialization and exception-valued log fields to fail.
findings.fix: Return a generic 503 and redact exception strings in JSON logs while logging server context.
findings.remaining_risk: Central log destination and retention were not live-verified.

findings.summary: Passing suites exited nonzero during global temporary-directory cleanup with WinError 5.
findings.reproduction: Run pytest with the system temp root on this Windows host.
findings.fix: Use repository-local basetemp for backend and isolated premium tests.
findings.regression_test: Default pytest commands completed 38 passed/2 skipped and 59 passed/3 skipped.
findings.remaining_risk: Starlette reports a non-blocking httpx deprecation warning.

findings.summary: The application has titles/descriptions and an icon but no explicit canonical URL, robots route, sitemap, or social preview metadata.
findings.reproduction: Inspect frontend/app metadata routes and public output.
findings.fix: Deferred until the canonical production hostname and share-image policy are confirmed.
findings.remaining_risk: Preview/pilot functionality is unaffected; public search and link previews are incomplete.
